mechanicalNotes.finding: Its final work-order line is 'LET THE STRUCTURE SETTLE.', which contains no verb in the gate's wait-kind actionable set (wait, rest, observe, hold, remain, sleep, watch). It is therefore not listed in markerAndWorkOrderMap. It is also outside the eleven hit anchors: it is the rung after the anc.maw.repair-committed bloom. Recorded here so the omission is deliberate and visible, not a gap. No copy change is proposed; copy is protected under this lock.
